device_ready.description: Given all the criteria, is the device ready to be used

profiles_available.description: How many profiles/tags do we have for this device in state

profiles_updated_at.description: When was the last profile update in the state of the device

pending.description: Any pending state changes for the device tag

supported_product_ids.description:
List of device types that can potentially use this tag.
Includes devices that support the tag natively or through manual learning/training.
Does not include devices with hardware restrictions that make them incompatible.

incompatible_product_ids.description:
List of device types that cannot use this tag due to hardware limitations.
For example, DualScanPetDoor only supports FDX-B tags due to hardware constraints,
so all non-FDX-B tags will include DualScanPetDoor in this list.
These restrictions cannot be overcome through manual learning or configuration.
